system_overview.title: EnergySense India Data Provenance & Governance Standard

grid_india.name: Grid Controller of India Limited (Grid-India / POSOCO)
grid_india.statutory_role: National System Operator under Electricity Act 2003 (NLDC & 5 RLDCs)
grid_india.primary_data_type: SCADA Operational Telemetry & Daily Power Supply Position (PSP) Reports

cea.name: Central Electricity Authority (CEA)
cea.statutory_role: Technical Authority under Section 73 of Electricity Act 2003
cea.primary_data_type: Monthly Generation Statistics, Load Generation Balance Report (LGBR), National Installed Capacity

cerc.name: Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC)
cerc.statutory_role: Quasi-Judicial Economic Regulator under Section 76 of Electricity Act 2003
cerc.primary_data_type: Tariff Orders, Interstate Transmission Regulations, Monthly Market Monitoring (IEX/PXIL/HPX)
cerc.note: CERC is an economic regulator and does not stream daily physical grid telemetry.

ember.name: Ember Climate Global Electricity Data Pipeline
ember.statutory_role: Independent Energy Think Tank & Open Data Provider
ember.primary_data_type: Monthly Clean Power, Thermal Generation & Emissions derived from CEA monthly reports

ecmwf.primary_data_type: Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI) 2m temperature & thermal comfort (2013-2020)

notable_gaps.impact: Deflated 2013 raw sum, causing naive 8.27% CAGR error

negative_deficit_records.policy: Preserved in raw SQLite database and audit log; clamped to 0 MW for visual charts with explicit audit footnote

cagr_audit.explanation: 2013 had 271 recorded days (2,645.0 MU/day) vs 364 days in 2023 (4,358.2 MU/day). Comparing normalized daily means yields 5.12%.

faq.q: Can we get live feed or post-April 2024 data from official websites?
faq.a: Yes. Grid-India publishes daily PSP reports every morning at 09:00 IST in PDF format, and Vidyut Pravah provides 15-minute dispatch snapshots. Our daily series was frozen on April 28, 2024 to match the published peer-reviewed benchmark (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.14983362) for reproducible, leak-free machine learning evaluations. Note that Tab 4 (Fuel Mix) already extends into late 2025 via Ember's live CEA pipeline.

faq.q: Is the data fully corrected, and are there ambiguities with CERC/CEA reports?
faq.a: The data reflects raw operational reality with audited corrections. Operational telemetry from Grid-India (SCADA transducers) naturally diverges by 0.5% to 2.5% from CEA/RPC commercial settlement accounts (Special Energy Meters) due to transmission wheeling losses and auxiliary power deductions. The 6 negative deficit records in raw telemetry are cataloged and audited.

faq.q: What official APIs and datasets are available in India?
faq.a: Official sources include the CEA Data API Portal (cea.nic.in), National Power Portal (npp.gov.in), NITI Aayog ICED (iced.niti.gov.in), Open Government Data (data.gov.in), and Vidyut Pravah (vidyutpravah.in). Ember provides a free, open REST API for monthly generation statistics.
